info.title: Toy Mart BD API
info.description: Toy Mart BD API v1, grouped by audience: storefront, admin, webhooks. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents (`application/problem+json`, schema `ProblemDetails`); branch on `type`, never on `title`/`detail`. Routes marked with the `Idempotency-Key` header replay a completed 2xx response for 24h (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`).

BlogTermRequest.description:
Create or edit a blog category (`/blog/categories`), tag (`/blog/tags`) or author
(`/blog/authors`). `slug` omitted keeps the current one (new: generated from the name).
`description(_bn)` is a category description or an author bio; `position` is for
categories, `avatar_media_id` and `user_id` for authors.
BlogTermRequest.title: BlogTermRequest

ready_since.description: When it was packed (ready_to_ship), else when it was confirmed.

weight_grams.description: Sum of variant weights × quantity (what bulk booking sends).

weight_missing.description: A line has no variant weight: the parcel would be understated.

cod_amount.description: What the courier collects: the order's due total, never negative.

submitted_at.description: When the booking was handed to the courier without an id (bulk / uncertain).

production.description: Production: an unverified courier cannot book (rule 33a).

cutoff_time.description: Today's pickup cut-off, "HH:MM" Asia/Dhaka (Settings → Delivery areas).

today.description: Today's Dhaka date (Y-m-d) — what "booked today" counts (rule 11).

reason.description: No zone mapped to the area, or several (bulk cannot choose; the booking drawer can).

upazila.description: Null: a district-level address (e.g. Dhaka city).

district_name.description: The name as written on the orders, when the geography row is missing.

multi_branch.description: True: multiple branches (per-branch stock, transfers, a branch on purchases and the till). False: a single shop.

saved.description: False while the owner has not chosen: the mode then follows the data (more than one active location = multi).

blockers.description:
Active locations other than the default: what stops switching to a single shop, with
the units still on hand there (to move with a transfer before switching it off).

BulkConfirmOrdersRequest.description:
`POST /orders/bulk/confirm` — needs orders.confirm. Up to 100 ids (one board page is
25). Unknown ids are not a validation error: they come back as `not_found` results,
so a stale selection still reports per order.
BulkConfirmOrdersRequest.title: BulkConfirmOrdersRequest

BulkFulfilOrdersRequest.description:
`POST /orders/bulk/ship` and `POST /orders/bulk/deliver` — manual fulfilment of many
orders from the board. Needs orders.update + shipments.book. Up to 100 ids; unknown ids
come back as `not_found` results. `courier_name` (ship only) applies to every order.

courier_name.description: Bulk ship only: the courier every parcel was handed to. Ignored by bulk deliver.

BulkFulfilOrdersRequest.title: BulkFulfilOrdersRequest

BulkGenerateBarcodesRequest.description:
`POST /products/barcodes` — every active variant without a barcode, of each of
`product_ids` (≤ 200), gets an in-store EAN-13 (GenerateVariantBarcodes). Needs
catalog.update. A barcode that is already set is never replaced.
BulkGenerateBarcodesRequest.title: BulkGenerateBarcodesRequest

BulkMediaRequest.description:
`POST /media/bulk/delete` and `POST /media/bulk/download` — `{ ids }`, 1–200 distinct
integers. Both need media.delete (deleteAny). Delete reports unknown ids as
`not_found`; the zip refuses them (422 on `ids.N`).
BulkMediaRequest.title: BulkMediaRequest

BulkMoveMediaRequest.description:
`POST /media/bulk/move` — `{ ids, folder_id }`: 1–200 distinct existing media ids and
a folder id, or null to un-file. Needs media.manage.
BulkMoveMediaRequest.title: BulkMoveMediaRequest

BulkPackOrdersRequest.description:
`POST /orders/bulk/pack` — mark many orders packed (→ ready to ship), needs
orders.update. Up to 100 ids; unknown ids come back as `not_found` results.
BulkPackOrdersRequest.title: BulkPackOrdersRequest

BulkRequestShipmentsRequest.description:
`POST /shipments/bulk` — send many orders to one courier from the board. Needs
orders.update + shipments.book; `Idempotency-Key` required. Up to 100 ids; unknown ids
come back as `not_found` results.

provider.description: Courier provider code. Omitted: the active default provider.

BulkRequestShipmentsRequest.title: BulkRequestShipmentsRequest

messenger.description: The Facebook Page username or numeric id behind `https://m.me/{messenger}`.

default_names.description: What invoices print while a name is unset (the brand name).

hotline_default.description: The hotline order messages use while none is saved here (env `STORE_HOTLINE`).

placeholders.description: Fields of this section an invoice still prints as "[placeholder]".

CancelOrderRequest.description:
`POST /orders/{order}/cancel` — needs orders.cancel. `reason` is the fixed list
(cancellations are counted by cause); `note` is required when the reason is `other`.
CancelOrderRequest.title: CancelOrderRequest

CancelShipmentRequest.description: `POST /shipments/{shipment}/cancel` — only pending or failed shipments; needs shipments.cancel.
CancelShipmentRequest.title: CancelShipmentRequest

CancellationReason.description: Why an order was cancelled (P4-ORD-09). A fixed list so cancellations can be counted by cause; `Other` requires a free-text note. Feeds the risk profile through OrderCancelled — `FakeOrder` and `CustomerUnreachable` are the signals that matter there.
CancellationReason.title: CancellationReason

reversed_at.description: When the reversal was recorded (ISO 8601 UTC); the reversal's own date is its `occurred_on`.

CapitalEntryKind.description: `capital_entries.kind` (P10 owner capital): money the owner or a partner put in, or took out. Each kind posts its own ledger type; both are cash, never revenue (rule 10).
CapitalEntryKind.title: CapitalEntryKind

CapitalHolderRequest.description:
A capital holder, for `POST /finance/capital/holders` and `PATCH …/{holder}`: `name`
(unique), optional `name_bn`, `role` (`owner`|`partner`, default owner), optional `user_id` (a staff account, one holder per account)
and `is_active`. Needs finance.manage_capital.
CapitalHolderRequest.title: CapitalHolderRequest

CapitalHolderRole.description: `capital_holders.role` (P10): what the person is to the business. A label only — no shares, no profit split.
CapitalHolderRole.title: CapitalHolderRole

token.description: Opaque cart token: store it in an httpOnly cookie and send it back as `X-Cart-Token`.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601, UTC. Extended by every change.

items.description:
One entry per line. `sellable` false: the item can no longer be bought (it is
excluded from every total; remove it). `in_stock` false: `quantity` exceeds
`available_quantity` (checkout will refuse until it is lowered). `image` is the
variant's own photo, else the product's primary, else its first (a 160px rendition;
null until one is processed). `variant.attributes` are the variant-defining values,
in attribute order (e.g. Colour: Red), each with its Bangla label when set.

coupon.description:
The coupon on the cart, if any. `applied` false: `reason` (stable code) and
`message` (localised) say why; the cart keeps it so the customer sees why.

adjustments.description:
Signed rows in pipeline order (subtotal, each promotion and the coupon as
negatives, then delivery) that sum exactly to `totals.grand_total`.

totals.description:
`shipping_charge` is null without a destination (`?district_id=`) or when it is not
serviced; `grand_total` then excludes delivery.

anyOf.description: The delivery quote for the requested destination — the same object `GET /delivery-quote` returns, for this cart.

checkout_ready.description: Every line sellable and in stock, the coupon (if any) applied and a serviced destination given.

CategoryStatus.description: `categories.status`. A category is archived rather than deleted, because products reference it through `primary_category_id` and `category_product`.
CategoryStatus.title: CategoryStatus

ChargePosSaleRequest.description:
`POST /pos/sessions/{session}/sales` — Charge. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` (rule 17).
`expected_total` is the total the cashier saw; a different server total is `price-changed`.

coupon_code.description: A storefront coupon; applied by the same rules as checkout. Needs `customer_phone`.

customer_phone.description: Bangladeshi mobile (013–019, rule 30). Optional — an anonymous walk-in has none.

discount.description: The cashier's discount, taken off the goods after promotions and the coupon. Capped by the store (`discount_max_percent` on the quote).

type.description: `percent` of the goods, or a flat `amount` in taka.

reason.description: Why — one of the fixed reasons, kept with the sale.

method.description: `due` puts that amount on the customer's due (needs `pos.sell_on_due`, a phone and a name).

amount.description: What the customer handed over in this tender, e.g. `4000.00` cash for a ৳3,455 total.

reference.description: bKash / Nagad TrxID or the card slip's approval code. Required for every non-cash tender.

customer_name.description: Printed on the receipt for a new customer; an existing customer keeps their name (a "Walk-in customer" placeholder is replaced). A due tender needs a name.

ChargePosSaleRequest.title: ChargePosSaleRequest

CheckoutRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/checkout` (P4-STO-09, docs/api/checkout.md). The cart comes from
`X-Cart-Token`; the body is what the customer typed plus `expected_total`, the grand
total they were shown — compared, never used, by PlaceOrder.

Address: division → district → upazila → area + line + landmark (rule 31). The
upazila is required unless the district offers its city as the empty option
(`city_option` on GET /districts — Dhaka city is not an upazila).

payment_method.description: `cod`, or an online method `GET /payment-methods` lists as enabled (P4-PAY-02).

expected_total.description: The grand total the customer was shown, e.g. "1930.00".

tracking.description:
Optional (P7 server-side tracking, docs/api/tracking.md §2.3): the shopper's
browser context and consent, for the server-side `purchase`. Same `client` +
`consent` shape as `POST /tracking/events`.

CheckoutRequest.title: CheckoutRequest

guest_checkout.description: Always true: checkout finds or creates the customer by phone; no account needed. Not configurable.

cash_on_delivery.description: Always true: COD is accepted in every serviced zone (rule 33). Not configurable.

online_methods.description: Online payment methods checkout accepts right now, besides COD.

order_notes.description: Always true: the customer note is accepted and stored. Not configurable.

cod_advance.description:
The COD advance rule checkout applies (held until staff arrange it by phone);
null = no rule. Zones are `inside_dhaka_metro` | `dhaka_suburb` | `outside_dhaka`.

free_shipping_threshold.description: Subtotal at or above which delivery is free in every zone; null = off. Edited via PUT /settings/delivery.

delivery_courier.description: The default courier whose rate card prices the customer's delivery charge; null = none active.

delivery_charges.description: Base charge per zone the customer is quoted (before weight surcharge); null when no courier is active.

ClosePosSessionRequest.description: `POST /pos/sessions/{session}/close` — close with the counted cash. Own drawer with pos.use; anyone's with pos.manage.

counted_cash.description: The cash counted in the drawer, float included.

note.description: Why the count is over or short, if it is.

ClosePosSessionRequest.title: ClosePosSessionRequest

ClosePurchaseRequest.description:
`POST /purchases/{purchase}/close` — close a partly received PO short; needs
purchasing.create (like cancelling) and a reason. 409 unless partially received.

reason.description: Why the rest will not arrive (supplier out of stock, discontinued …).

ClosePurchaseRequest.title: ClosePurchaseRequest

video_lengths.description: What is known about each video reel link's length (looked up after save; the editor's typed length wins on the storefront).

path.description: Locale-free storefront path.

seo.description: Stored seo_meta overrides plus the defaults an empty field falls back to.

CmsPageRequest.description:
`POST /content/pages` and `PUT /content/pages/{page}` — the whole page document. `slug` null
keeps the current slug (or generates one from the title). `published_at` is an ISO 8601
instant (the admin sends Dhaka time with its +06:00 offset); with `status: published` a
future instant schedules the page. Changing a live page's slug needs
`acknowledge_slug_redirect: true` — the old URL then 301s (slug_history).

content.description: Rich text (HTML from the admin editor); sanitised on save.

seo.description: Search & social (seo_meta, type `page`). Omitted: keep; sent: replace.

CmsPageRequest.title: CmsPageRequest

customer_phone.description: The customer's mobile, as typed (013–019, rule 30).

amount.description: What the customer handed over in this tender; cash may exceed the due (change).

reference.description: bKash / Nagad TrxID or the card slip's approval code. Required for every non-cash tender.

CompleteRegistrationRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/auth/register/verify` (owner decision 2026-11-20) — the `register` code plus
the new account's name and password. An optional `X-Cart-Token` names the guest cart to merge.
CompleteRegistrationRequest.title: CompleteRegistrationRequest

note.description: Shown on the order's activity timeline next to the change.

ConnectMessengerPageRequest.description:
`POST /settings/inbox-channels/messenger/connect` — the Page chosen after "Continue with
 * Facebook"; needs settings.manage_integrations.

page_id.description: One of the Page ids that call returned.

ConnectMessengerPageRequest.title: ConnectMessengerPageRequest

ConsentConfirmationMethod.description: How staff confirmed a customer agreed to a purpose consent (P8 batch 3, owner decision 2026-11-13). Required when staff record a "yes" in the admin; null for a storefront opt-in.
ConsentConfirmationMethod.title: ConsentConfirmationMethod

ContactMessageRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/contact-messages` — the Contact page's "Send us a message" form (owner
decision 2026-11-16). The phone is a Bangladeshi mobile, 013–019 only (rule 30), and is
stored as E.164. The order number is optional and as forgiving as order tracking's
("26-00042", Bengali digits), stored in its canonical form.
ContactMessageRequest.title: ContactMessageRequest

ContactTopic.description: What a storefront contact-form message is about (Contact page, owner decision 2026-11-16).
ContactTopic.title: ContactTopic

batch.description: Bulk-generated codes share a batch label (coupon builder, P7).

CouponType.description:
`coupons.type` (DATABASE-DESIGN §3.8). | | |---| | `fixed`
`value` taka off the eligible goods, never more than they cost. | | `percent`
`value` percent off the eligible goods, capped at `max_discount`. | | `free_shipping`
Delivery becomes free (DATABASE-DESIGN §5.1 step 1); goods are not discounted. |
CouponType.title: CouponType

ok.description: The courier accepted the saved credentials.

balance.description: Steadfast: the balance it reported (can be negative).

store_name.description: Pathao: the pickup store the saved id points at.

sandbox.description: Pathao: the check ran against Pathao's test server.

is_active.description: False once the courier stopped returning this row; a mapping on it no longer books.

mapped.description: Active rows a human has mapped.

mapped_inactive.description: Mapped rows the courier no longer serves — bookings there are blocked until re-mapped.

candidates.description: One query per relation for the whole list, not two per candidate (Phase 9 N+1 guard).

provider.description: The provider filter, or null for every courier.

districts.description: `district` null = shipments whose order has no district.

upazila_id.description: Null for a district-level place (an address with no upazila, such as Dhaka city).

waiting_orders.description: Open orders (not yet shipped) addressed here — what booking through this courier would block.

mapped_count.description: Courier rows a human has mapped to exactly this place.

verified.description: A booking has succeeded through this driver (rule 33a). Set by the booking flow, never by this screen.

requires_location_mapping.description: Booking needs a mapped courier_locations row (Pathao yes, Steadfast no — rule 32).

credential_fields.description: The provider's credential keys; `hint` is "••••1234" at most.

webhook_url.description: The URL to register in the courier's merchant panel.

balance.description: Last balance the provider reported; null = never checked.

line_count.description: Detail only: how many lines the statement has ("14 parcels on this statement").

pending_by_type.description:
Detail only: the lines still waiting for a decision, per variance type — how many and the
size of the gap (Σ |variance|, a decimal string), for "Short ৳100.00 · 1 not ours · 1 missing".

score.description: 0–1 name similarity (city ~ district, zone ~ upazila). Not a confidence in the mapping.

reason.description:
Why it was issued: the order was cancelled after the invoice, a refund was paid, the
order was edited down after issue, or the courier returned it (RTO; P8 batch 3).

source_reference.description: The order number (cancellation, edit, courier return) or the RMA number (refund), as issued.

issued_to_name.description: Customer name, as on the invoice.

can_print.description: Whether this user may print it (orders.view + customers.view_pii).

invoice_issued_at.description: When the credited invoice was issued. ISO 8601, UTC.

note.description: The refund's reason text (refund credit notes) or the edit's note (order_edited); null otherwise.

adjustment.description: Signed: what the parts above do not explain (e.g. a refund capped below its lines).

issued_by.description: The company details as at the credit note's issue.

issued_to.description: The customer as on the invoice; PII masked without customers.view_pii.

reason.description:
Why it was issued: the order was cancelled after the invoice, a refund was paid, the
order was edited down after issue, or the courier returned it (RTO; P8 batch 3).

source_reference.description: The order number (cancellation, edit, courier return) or the RMA number (refund), as issued.

issued_to_name.description: Customer name, as on the invoice.

can_print.description: Whether this user may print it (orders.view + customers.view_pii).

CropProductImageRequest.description:
`POST /products/{product}/images/{image}/crop` — `{ x, y, width, height }` in the
image's current pixels (`width` × `height` on the resource). Needs catalog.update.
CropProductImageRequest.title: CropProductImageRequest

thresholds.description: Segment thresholds in force — PLACEHOLDERS until the owner sets them (config/customers.php).

segments.description: One row per segment in precedence order, every segment present.

lifetime_value.description: Over customers with a delivered lifetime value above zero. `to` null = open-ended bucket.

repeat_purchase.description: All time: customers with 2+ delivered orders ÷ customers with 1+.

period.description: Customers who placed a non-cancelled order in the range: first-time vs returning.

cohorts.description:
Acquisition cohorts by the Dhaka month of the first non-cancelled order, for every
month the range touches. `retention[k]` = share of the cohort that ordered in month k.

top_customers.description: Highest lifetime values; phone always masked.

name.description: First name or nickname, if the parent gave one.

age.description: Whole years today (Dhaka); null without a birth year.

next_birthday.description: Y-m-d (Dhaka): the next day the birthday is celebrated, today included.

has_account.description: A storefront account: the phone was verified by OTP at least once.

district.description: Latest order's district name (as entered on the order).

lifetime_value.description: Delivered revenue from the ledger (order_financials), decimal string.

children_count.description: How many children the parent told us about (P8 batch 3) — told to every role.

children.description:
The children (first name/nickname, birthday, optional year → age) — children's data,
so only with customers.view_pii (rule 20); null otherwise.

average_order_value.description: lifetime_value ÷ delivered orders; null before a delivery.

delivery_success_rate.description: delivered ÷ (delivered + returned) × 100, two places; null with neither.

orders_truncated.description: True when there are more orders than `orders` lists (open the order board filtered by customer).

previous.description: The comparison range the deltas are against.

status.description: Live order counts by status (not range-bound) and the open pipeline. Needs orders.view.

trend.description:
Placed value / orders / units per bucket against the comparison range (aligned by
position), and recognised revenue per bucket when finance is visible (else null).

categories.description: Recognised item revenue of the orders delivered in the range, by top-level category.

attention.description:
Live queues the viewer may act on — count and the oldest item's age; only the queues
the viewer's permissions allow are listed.

activity.description: Newest order timeline events, structured only — no notes, descriptions or customer data.

DeliverOrderRequest.description:
`POST /orders/{order}/deliver` — manual delivery confirmation (P5, until Phase 6
courier status updates). Needs orders.update + shipments.book.

note.description: Shown on the order's activity timeline next to the change.

DeliverOrderRequest.title: DeliverOrderRequest

cutoff_time.description: Dhaka wall-clock "HH:MM"; orders at or after it dispatch the next working day.

eta_days.description: Working days from dispatch to delivery, per zone.

metro_district_ids.description:
Districts inside Dhaka metro as a whole — every address in them, with or without an
upazila (owner decision 2026-11-15); not-serviced upazilas still win.

suburb_district_ids.description: Whole districts priced as Dhaka suburb.

cod_advance.description:
COD orders above `threshold` in `zones` need `amount` paid in advance. Disabled =
no rule (zones empty, money null). Money as decimal strings.

upazila_required.description: The district alone does not settle the charge: ask for the upazila.

subtotal.description: The goods value the quote is for (variant price × quantity).

charge.description: What the customer pays for delivery — "0.00" when free.

standard_charge.description:
base_charge + weight_surcharge: the charge before any free delivery (struck
through when free).

free_shipping.description:
`progress_percent` is the subtotal as a whole percent of the threshold (0–100,
rounded down) for the free-delivery meter; null when there is no threshold.

cod_advance.description: Advance payment a COD order of this value needs in this zone, or null.

free_shipping_threshold.description: Subtotal at or above which delivery is free in every zone; null = off.

DeliveryZone.description: Our delivery-charge tier (DATABASE-DESIGN §5.1). Says nothing about a courier's own zone ids, which live in courier_locations and are never guessed (rule 32).
DeliveryZone.title: DeliveryZone

DiscountReason.description: Why a cashier gave a discount — a fixed list (owner request 2026-11-15), so the reasons can be counted. Stored as the code on `pos_sales.discount_reason`; each screen shows its own language's label.
DiscountReason.title: DiscountReason

DraftInboxReplyRequest.description:
`POST /inbox/conversations/{conversation}/ai-draft` — a suggested reply; needs inbox.reply
(the conversation policy's `reply`). Nothing is sent.

style.description: `default` (the customer's language, 3 sentences at most), `shorter`, `english` or `bangla`.

DraftInboxReplyRequest.title: DraftInboxReplyRequest

ExpenseCategoryRequest.description:
An expense category, for `POST /finance/expense-categories` and `PATCH …/{category}`.
`parent_id` must be a top-level category (one level of nesting) and not itself.
`ledger_type` (optional) names the ledger type its expenses post as.
ExpenseCategoryRequest.title: ExpenseCategoryRequest

ExpenseDecisionRequest.description:
`POST /finance/expenses/{expense}/approve|reject|void`. Reject and void need a `reason`
(kept on the expense); approve takes none. The ability checked is the route's action.
ExpenseDecisionRequest.title: ExpenseDecisionRequest

ExpensePaymentMethod.description: How an expense was paid. A null `payment_method` means not paid yet (an accrual).
ExpensePaymentMethod.title: ExpensePaymentMethod

ExpenseReceiptRequest.description: `POST /finance/expenses/{expense}/receipt` — multipart `receipt`: a PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP ≤ 10 MB (by content).
ExpenseReceiptRequest.title: ExpenseReceiptRequest

ExpenseRecurrence.description: `expenses.recurrence` of a recurring template: generated on the 1st of each due month (Dhaka).
ExpenseRecurrence.title: ExpenseRecurrence

ExpenseRequest.description:
The expense document, for `POST /finance/expenses` (JSON or `multipart/form-data` with an
optional `receipt` file) and `PATCH /finance/expenses/{expense}` (JSON; the receipt has its
own endpoint). Money is a decimal string > 0. Dates are Dhaka dates (YYYY-MM-DD) and an
expense cannot be dated in the future. A null `payment_method` means "not paid yet".
ExpenseRequest.title: ExpenseRequest

order_number.description:
The order's number when the source is the order itself (`order`, `order_reversal`), so the
screen can say "Order #TM-…" rather than an internal id; null for every other source.

FinishMessengerLoginRequest.description:
`POST /settings/inbox-channels/messenger/login/finish` — the `code` and `state` Facebook added
to the redirect back to Inbox › Channels › Facebook Page; needs settings.manage_integrations.

code.description: The `code` query parameter Facebook sent back (valid for a few minutes).

state.description: The `state` query parameter: the one-time value from `…/messenger/login`.

FinishMessengerLoginRequest.title: FinishMessengerLoginRequest

Gender.description: `products.gender` — nullable: most toys need no gender at all.
Gender.title: Gender

GenerateBarcodesRequest.description:
`POST /products/{product}/barcodes` — give this product's variants without a barcode an
in-store EAN-13 (GenerateVariantBarcodes). Needs catalog.update. `variant_ids` (optional)
picks some of ITS variants, any status; without it every active variant without a barcode
gets one. A barcode that is already set is never replaced.

variant_ids.description: Some of this product's variants (any status); omit for every active variant without a barcode.

GenerateBarcodesRequest.title: GenerateBarcodesRequest

GenerateCouponsRequest.description:
`POST /coupons/generate` (coupon builder, P7) — the coupon document without `code`,
plus `count` (1–1000), `prefix` (optional, ≤ 12), `code_length` (6–16, default 8) and
`batch` (the campaign label the codes share). Needs marketing.manage.
GenerateCouponsRequest.title: GenerateCouponsRequest

ai.description: `configured`: the advisor's provider has a key. `figures_shared`: report figures may be sent (the advisor refuses without them).

brief.description: Null until the first brief is written. `from`/`to` are the Dhaka dates covered (Monday to Sunday, or this week to date).

open_count.description: Open suggestions under the latest brief.

done_this_month.description: Suggestions marked done since the 1st of this Dhaka month.

HoldOrderRequest.description:
`POST /orders/{order}/hold` — needs orders.update. A hold always says why (`reason`),
so whoever picks the order up next knows what is being waited on.

reason.description: Why the order is paused, e.g. "Customer asked to deliver after Friday".

HoldOrderRequest.title: HoldOrderRequest

coupon_code.description: A storefront coupon; applied by the same rules as checkout. Needs `customer_phone`.

customer_phone.description: Bangladeshi mobile (013–019, rule 30). Optional — an anonymous walk-in has none.

label.description: Optional name to find it again, e.g. `Blue shirt, coming back`.

customer_name.description: The customer's name, kept with `customer_phone` so resuming restores the named customer.

ImportSettlementRequest.description:
`POST /finance/settlements` — import one courier remittance: `provider` (courier code),
`reference` (the courier's payment id), `received_at` (Dhaka date, not in the future),
optional `period_start`/`period_end` (both or neither; enables MISSING-line detection) and
`note`; then EITHER `file` (the portal export, CSV or XLSX, ≤ 5 MB) OR `lines[]` typed in
(`consignment_id`, `cod_amount`, optional `delivery_charge`, `cod_fee`, `return_charge`,
`net_amount`; ≤ 500). Needs finance.reconcile_cod and an `Idempotency-Key`.
ImportSettlementRequest.title: ImportSettlementRequest

driver.description: The configured send driver; `log` sends nothing.

account_id.description: WhatsApp: the phone number id. Messenger: the Page id.

business_account_id.description: WhatsApp only: the WhatsApp Business Account id ("Sync from Meta"). Null for Messenger.

human_agent.description: Messenger only: reply with the HUMAN_AGENT tag for up to 7 days. Always false for WhatsApp.

send_token.description: WhatsApp access token / Messenger Page access token. Hint "••••1234" at most.

app_secret.description: Meta App Secret — keys the X-Hub-Signature-256 check.

verify_token.description: The verify token for Meta's subscription handshake.

webhook_url.description: Absolute callback URL to give Meta (from APP_URL).

webhook_ready.description: App secret and verify token are both set.

send_ready.description: Account id and send token are both set.

verified.description: Always false until a real account has been connected and watched.

last_check.description:

connection.description:

activity.description:

page_name.description: Messenger: the Page's name, saved by "Continue with Facebook".

connected_at.description: Messenger: when the Page was connected with Facebook (ISO 8601).

app_id.description: Messenger: Toy Mart's Meta App ID.

login_config_id.description: Messenger: the Facebook Login for Business configuration ID (null = the login asks for the permissions by name).

login_ready.description: Messenger: App ID and App secret are set, so "Continue with Facebook" can start.

oauth_redirect_uri.description: Messenger: paste into the Meta app's "Valid OAuth Redirect URIs".

ok.description: Meta answered the read with these credentials.

display_name.description: WhatsApp: the verified business name. Messenger: the Page name.

display_number.description: WhatsApp only: the number as Meta displays it.

quality_rating.description: WhatsApp only: GREEN | YELLOW | RED | NA (Meta's value, passed through).

error_code.description: `not_configured`, `unreachable`, `meta_{graph error code}` (e.g. meta_190 = token invalid or expired) or `http_{status}`.

error_message.description: Meta's own error text, token scrubbed, ≤ 300 characters.

actor.description: Who did it: a staff name, or `customer` for an automatic reopen.

template.description: Meta's template name and language code (kind `template`).

tag.description: The Messenger message tag the reply went (or goes) with.

at.description: When it was written (inbound: the provider's timestamp).

key.description: The library key (`order.confirmed`, `custom.*`): the admin labels a system template by it.

name.description: A staff-made template's own name; null for a system template.

count.description: Open conversations with unread messages or waiting on a staff reply, each counted once.

how many units are resellable and how many damaged; they must add up to the line's

InspectReturnRequest.title: InspectReturnRequest

key.description: Stable service key: pathao, steadfast, redx, cod, sslcommerz, paystation, bkash, nagad, sms, whatsapp, messenger, meta_capi, ga4, gtm, search_console.

status.description: `not_available` = no driver in the codebase yet.

notes.description: Factual note codes for the detail line, e.g. `no_credentials`, `sandbox`, `live`, `live_unverified`, `unverified_booking_blocked`, `bookings`, `browser_only`.

attention.description: Why it needs attention (a code), when `status` is `needs_attention`.

bookings_count.description: Shipments booked through this courier (with a consignment id).

enabled.description: Switched on/off where the service has such a switch; null when it has none.

courier_provider_id.description: The courier row, for `PATCH /settings/couriers/{id}` (the only on/off this screen offers).

can_toggle.description: This user may switch it on/off here (couriers only, shipments.manage_rates).

settings_path.description: The admin screen that configures it; null when none exists.

status.description:
`applied` (below the approval threshold, moved at once), `pending` (waiting for
approval, nothing moved), `approved` (moved when approved), `rejected` (never moved).

moved_stock.description: Whether this adjustment has written its stock movements.

requested_units.description: Units the request changes (absolute, summed) — what the approval threshold reads.

requested_value.description: Their value at weighted-average cost, 2 dp; only with catalog.view_cost.

items.description:
One per variant. `quantity_before`/`after` and `change` are provisional while pending

difference.description: actual − expected, for a drift alert.

alert_date.description: The Dhaka calendar day it was raised, YYYY-MM-DD.

location_id.description: The location counted — the default one.

count.description: Variants with 0 < available ≤ reorder point there (up to a minute old).

unit_cost.description: Unit cost the units moved at, 4 dp; only with catalog.view_cost.

reference_type.description: The source document: `stock_adjustment`, `stock_transfer`, `product` (opening stock), and later order, purchase, shipment, refund.

reference_number.description: The document's human number where it has one (ADJ-2026-0012, TRF-2026-0003).

adjustment_reason.description: The adjustment's reason, for an adjustment movement.

user_name.description: Staff member who recorded it; null for the system.

opening.description: On hand before the period (0 without `from`).

variants_checked.description: Variants (with a stock level in scope) whose ledger was checked.

drift_variant_ids.description: Up to 50 variant ids whose ledger sum differs from on_hand.

balanced.description: True when the ledger matches the stock levels for every variant in scope.

stock_value.description: Current stock value at cost in scope; only with catalog.view_cost.

available.description: on_hand − reserved. May be negative only if the ledger has drifted.

reorder_quantity.description: Units a reorder brings in; 0 = not set (the variant is then never overstock).

state.description:
`out` (available ≤ 0), `low` (0 < available ≤ reorder point), `overstock`
(reorder quantity set and available > reorder point + 2 × reorder quantity) or null.

unit_cost.description: Unit cost basis (weighted-average cost, else current cost price), 4 dp; only with catalog.view_cost.

value.description: on_hand × unit cost, 2 dp; only with catalog.view_cost.

elsewhere.description:
On hand and available at every other active location, in location order
(empty while there is only one location).

transfer_from.description:
For a low or out-of-stock row: the other location with the most units
available, the source a transfer would draw from; null when no other
location has any, or the row is not short.

location_id.description: The location the counts and the on-hand figures are for.

counts.description: Rows per tab: every variant, low (0 < available ≤ reorder point), out (available ≤ 0), overstock (reorder quantity set and available > reorder point + 2 × reorder quantity), idle (stock but no movement for 90 days).

reserved.description: Units held for open orders, not yet shipped.

value.description: Stock value at cost at this location; only with catalog.view_cost.

total_value.description: Stock value at cost across every active location; only with catalog.view_cost.

locations.description: Every active location, the default first. `value` only with catalog.view_cost.

status.description: Booked in one step: no in-transit state.

as_at.description: The Dhaka date valued (end of that day); null = the live projection.

data.description:
`unit_cost` is 4 dp; `value` = on_hand × unit_cost, 2 dp. `estimated` = as-at
row whose movements carried no cost, valued at today's cost basis.

LabelTemplate.description: Barcode label stock (owner request 2026-11-16). All sizes in millimetres. - `roll_38x25`, `roll_50x25` — one label per page, for the thermal roll printers common in   Bangladeshi shops (the printer driver's page size is the label). - `a4_65` — A4 sheet, 5 × 13 labels of 38.1 × 21.2 (Avery L7651: 10.7 top, 4.7 side margin,   2.5 column gap, no row gap). - `a4_24` — A4 sheet, 3 × 8 labels of 70 × 37, no gaps (the Avery 3474 layout). Products by distinct sessions over view_item in the window. Pages are not
available: the storefront never stores page_view.

characters after trimming. Uniqueness (case-insensitive) is checked by the Action
under a lock. Needs media.manage.
MediaFolderRequest.title: MediaFolderRequest

MenuLocation.title: MenuLocation

birthday.description:

and for SMS / email.

The phone's CURRENT profile (P6 risk module): our score now and the staff list
status — beside, never merged with, the snapshot above (rule 24).

What this user may do to the order now — the state machine and their permissions,
decided here so the client never re-derives a transition rule.

can_print_invoice.description: Whether this user may print the invoice / packing slip (orders.view + customers.view_pii).

packing-slip PDF (P4-ORD-08). Needs orders.view AND customers.view_pii: the slip

anomaly.description: Why this status combination should not exist, or null (spec A12 anomaly list).

writing anything (P4-ORD-06). Needs orders.create. Everything but the lines is
optional: without a district there is no delivery line; without a phone the
per-customer coupon checks wait for the save.

OrderQuoteRequest.title: OrderQuoteRequest

value.description: Σ unit price × quantity returned, for the list's VALUE column (the refund itself is `refund.amount`).

has_refund.description: A refund exists (shown in `refund` only with refunds.view).

OrderTrackRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/orders/track` (P4-STO-10, rule 22): order number **plus** phone
digits — the last 4 (B7.1) or the full number. The number is forgiving about case,

PaystationNotificationRequest.description:
A PayStation IPN (a JSON POST, sent only for successful transactions). PayStation
documents no signature, so validation here is shape only: it parses nothing into a
domain object, writes nothing, and nothing in it is ever trusted — the invoice number
only says which of OUR payments to re-query (rule 19, docs/_research/paystation-api.md §5).
PaystationNotificationRequest.title: PaystationNotificationRequest

PaystationReturnRequest.description:
The customer's browser came back from PayStation to our callback_url; the storefront
forwards the order number from that URL and, if PayStation appended one, the invoice
number. PayStation documents neither the redirect's parameters nor any signature, so
these only select which of OUR payments to re-query — never its status or amount
(rule 19, docs/_research/paystation-api.md §6). Everything else PayStation appended
may be forwarded in `query` and is kept for disputes only.
PaystationReturnRequest.title: PaystationReturnRequest

in any accepted spelling (rule 30). Lookup needs risk.view; rescore needs risk.verify
(it writes the profile projection).
PhoneLookupRequest.title: PhoneLookupRequest

item_costs_visible.description: False when the reader lacks catalog.view_cost.

buckets.description:
One bucket per period, oldest first, including empty ones. Without catalog.view_cost
the `cogs` line and the gross profit / profit after delivery / profit after losses
subtotals are null (cost of goods could be backed out of them).

generated_at.description: When the figures were read (ISO 8601) — the page's "figures as of".

blocks.description:
The five blocks in order. A `line` carries the ledger types it sums and how many
times they happened (entries in the natural direction, reversals not counted);
a `subtotal` is the running total after the lines above it. `percent_of_revenue`
is the row's (or block total's) signed share of net revenue, 2 dp, null without
revenue. `total` is the sum of the block's lines. Without catalog.view_cost the
cost-of-goods line's amount, share and occurrences, block 2's total, and
the gross profit / profit after delivery / profit after losses subtotals are null.

item_costs_visible.description: False when the reader lacks catalog.view_cost (cost of goods and every figure it can be backed out of are withheld).

biggest_costs.description:
Up to four lines in blocks 3–5 that took the most off profit, largest first, as
positive costs; `relative_percent` is each cost as a % of the largest (100.00 for it).

totals.description:
Running subtotals. Without catalog.view_cost, gross_profit, profit_after_delivery and
profit_after_losses are null (cost of goods could be backed out of them).

gross_margin_percent.description: Gross profit as % of net revenue, 2 dp; null without revenue or without catalog.view_cost.

net_margin_percent.description: Net profit as % of net revenue, 2 dp; null without revenue.

unmapped.description:
Recognised entries of a type that does not belong in a P&L (e.g. a cash-only
type flagged as revenue). Not counted above; should always be empty.

expenses_by_category.description: Recognised entries with an expense category, per category, largest cost first.

cash.description: Cash movements in the period (`is_cash_movement`), kept apart from the P&L.

reconciliation.description:
Recognised net split by whether the entry belongs to an order. `reconciled` is
true when the two parts add up to the statement's net profit. `difference` is the statement's net profit minus that rebuild (0.00 when it ties up).

open_orders.description:
Orders placed and not yet delivered, cancelled or returned — current, not per
period. Not in the statement. `by_status` splits them by order status (pipeline order), counts and order values.

inventory_at_cost.description: Inventory on hand at cost, now; only with catalog.view_cost. Not in the statement.

comparison.description: The comparison period's subtotals and the % change of each; null when `compare=none`.

source.description: Where the figures were read from.

available.description: Available at this branch now (on hand − reserved).

due_limit.description: Store-wide due limit per customer, e.g. `5000.00`.

rows.description: Signed rows that sum to `grand_total` (no delivery at the counter, so free-delivery promotions are left out).

discount.description:
The cashier's discount: `max_percent` is the cap (of the goods after promotions and the
coupon); `amount` what it came to ("0.00" when none, or over the cap — see `blockers`).

tenders.description: `tendered` is money handed over; `due` is what is put on the customer's due ("0.00" when none).

placeholders.description: Required business fields the owner has not filled in yet.

sold_at.description: ISO 8601 instant; print it in Dhaka time.

discount_reason.description: The reason code (`regular_customer`, `bulk_purchase`, … — the register shows its label).

due_amount.description: Put on the customer's due at this sale (not a payment — `payments` lists money only).

print.description:
How the receipt prints (Settings › Invoices, receipts & labels › Thermal receipt).
`language` `ask` = the cashier picks per sale; `en`/`bn` fixes it.

logo_url.description: The store logo (printed in black); null when none is chosen or the logo is switched off.

barcode_svg.description: Code 128 of the order number as a standalone SVG; null when the barcode is switched off.

whatsapp_link.description: The store's WhatsApp chat link (`https://wa.me/…`); null when switched off or no number is saved.

whatsapp_qr_svg.description: A QR code of `whatsapp_link` as a standalone SVG, or null.

due_amount.description: Put on the customer's due (no payment), "0.00" for a fully paid sale.

expected_cash.description: Cash the drawer should hold now: float + cash kept (sales and due collected).

due_sold.description: Put on customers' due by this drawer's sales — no money, never in expected cash.

due_collected.description: Due collected on this drawer (all tenders).

discount_saved.description: False while the store default applies (nobody has saved a cap yet).

due_saved.description: False while the store default applies.

PostType.description: An article, or a buying guide (structured sections with product picks), served under /guides.

PrintLabelsRequest.description:
`POST /products/labels` — barcode labels as one PDF. Needs catalog.view; with
`generate_missing: true` also catalog.update (it writes barcodes first), else 403.

`items[] {variant_id, copies}` — ≤ 300 items, copies 1–500, ≤ 5,000 labels in all; printed
in the order given. A variant without a barcode is a 422 on `items.N.variant_id` unless
`generate_missing` is true. Only the fields below are accepted; any other is a 422.

Every field but `items` and `locale` is optional and, when omitted, takes the value saved in
Settings › Invoices, receipts & labels › Barcode labels ({@see PrintSettings::labels()}, the

with catalog.update; for anyone else an omitted `generate_missing` is false, so a variant

template.description: The label stock; omitted, the saved Barcode labels paper.

show_price.description: Print the selling price; omitted, the saved setting.

show_name.description: Print the product name; omitted, the saved setting.

show_options.description: Print the variant's options line (size, colour); omitted, the saved setting.

show_store.description: Print the store name (in the label language) at the top; omitted, the saved setting.

show_digits.description: Print the barcode number under the bars; omitted, the saved setting.

locale.description: Language of the printed name, falling back to English (default `en`).

generate_missing.description:
Generate in-store EAN-13s for variants without a barcode first; `true` needs
catalog.update. Omitted, the saved setting for someone with catalog.update, else false.

PrintLabelsRequest.title: PrintLabelsRequest

saved.description: Documents saved at least once; the others print with the defaults.

type.description: Stable machine-readable problem type, e.g. `https://toymartbd.com/problems/validation-error`. Branch on this.

description.description:
Sanitised rich-text HTML: p, h2, h3, strong, em, ul, ol, li, blockquote, br,
a[href] and img[src, alt, width, height] from our own media only.

description_bn.description:
Sanitised rich-text HTML: p, h2, h3, strong, em, ul, ol, li, blockquote, br,
a[href] and img[src, alt, width, height] from our own media only.

is_live.description:
Live on the storefront now (active and `published_at` reached): its slug
changes only with `acknowledge_slug_redirect`.

sales_channels.description: Where the product is sold (stored flags).

vat_rate.description: VAT included in the selling price, percent, decimal string ("0.00").

compliance.description:
BSTI certification. `certificate` is the uploaded PDF (download it from
`GET /products/{product}/compliance/certificate`), null when none.
`expired`: the expiry date is before today (Dhaka).

margin.description:
Margin of the default variant (a simple product's price), computed by the
server; only with catalog.view_cost. Null when its price or cost is not set.

margin_lowest.description:
The lowest variant margin (archived variants included) and its variant;
only with catalog.view_cost. Null when no variant has a margin.

stock_by_location.description:
Stock of all the product's variants per location (on hand, reserved,
available); only with inventory.view. Read-only — change it with a stock
adjustment.

slug_history.description: Retired slugs that now 301 to this product (newest first).

seo.description: Search & social (seo_meta), with the server's defaults, measurement and checklist.

options.description:
The selected values of each variant-defining attribute, derived from the
active variants. Empty for a simple product.

en.description: English copy. `description_html` uses only p, ul, li and strong. `too_long` lists keys still over their limit (title 70, seo_title 60, meta_description 160); `unknown_figures` lists numbers that match no fact.

bn.description: Bangla copy, Western digits; same shape as `en`.

model.description: The model that wrote the draft, e.g. `claude-opus-5-5`.

facts.description: The facts the AI was given, from the product itself. `key` is stable; `value` is what the AI saw (long text shortened).

ProductCopyRequest.description: `POST /products/{product}/ai-copy` — what to write, in which language and tone; needs catalog.update.

fields.description: What to write: the title, the description, and/or the SEO title with meta description.

keywords.description: Search keywords to work in where they fit the facts.

ProductCopyRequest.title: ProductCopyRequest

create_count.description: Rows that create (preview: would create) a product.

update_count.description: Rows that update (preview: would update) a product.

error_count.description: Rows with at least one problem; they are not written.

row.description: Spreadsheet row number (the header is row 1); 0 for a problem with the file itself.

column.description: The column the problem belongs to; null for the row (or file) as a whole.

related_product.description:
`image_url`: the primary image's 160 px rendition (null when none is ready);
`price`: the default variant's selling price, decimal string.

ProductScopeType.description: What a coupon or promotion applies to (`coupons.applies_to`, promotion `rules.scope.applies_to`).
ProductScopeType.title: ProductScopeType

defaults.description: What an empty override falls back to.

url.description: The canonical storefront URL of the product.

measure.description:
Estimated rendered widths of the effective title and description at Google's
desktop metric (see POST /products/seo-measure for unsaved text).

checklist.description:
The saved product's SEO checklist. `key` ∈ title_fits, description_fits,
primary_image, image_alt, slug, product_schema, sitemap.

schema.description: The effective Product JSON-LD (generated, with `schema_override` merged on top).

ProductStatus.description: `products.status`. `draft` is invisible to the storefront; `active` is live once `published_at` has passed; `archived` is retired but kept (orders reference it).
ProductStatus.title: ProductStatus

ProductType.description: `products.type`. A simple product has exactly one (default) variant; a variable product has one variant per combination of its selected attribute values. Either way the variant is the unit of inventory (DATABASE-DESIGN §1.1).
ProductType.title: ProductType

cost_price.description: Current replacement cost; only with catalog.view_cost.

margin.description:
Per-unit margin at this price and cost, VAT taken out, before delivery and COD
costs — computed by the server. Only with catalog.view_cost; null when the
price or the cost is not set.

stock.description:
Current stock at all locations; only with inventory.view. Read-only here:
opening stock is set on create (`opening_stock`), later changes are
stock adjustments (Phase 5).

attribute_values.description: One value per variant-defining attribute; empty for a simple product.

totals.description: Over every row, not only the returned ones.

PromotionType.description:
`promotions.type` (DATABASE-DESIGN §3.8). `rules` shape per type is documented in docs/api/promotions.md and read by {@see \App\Domain\Marketing\Services\PromotionEngine}. | | |---| | `discount`
Percent or fixed-per-unit off every eligible line (the general "percentage / fixed" promotion). | | `flash_sale`
Hard-windowed sale. With `flash_sale_items` rows: each listed variant at its sale price for a limited allotment. Without: percent/fixed like `discount` (Phase 4 rows). | | `category_discount`
As `discount`; the Phase 4 name, kept so existing rows and reports still read. | | `tiered`
Percent or fixed off the eligible subtotal, by the highest tier reached. | | `buy_x_get_y`
For every `buy` + `get` eligible units, the `get` cheapest are discounted by `percent`. | | `bundle`
Percent or fixed off — or a fixed `price` for — each complete set of `product_ids`. | | `free_delivery`
Delivery becomes free when the eligible goods (after discounts) reach `min_subtotal`. |
PromotionType.title: PromotionType

PublishCmsLayoutRequest.description: `POST /content/home/publish` — an optional note for the version history.
PublishCmsLayoutRequest.title: PublishCmsLayoutRequest

closed_at.description: When a partly received PO was closed short.

shipping_cost.description: Header column, legacy: receipts before 2026-11-16 added their extras here. Read `extra_costs`.

customs_duty.description: Header column, legacy: receipts before 2026-11-16 added their extras here. Read `extra_costs`.

other_cost.description: Header column, legacy: receipts before 2026-11-16 added their extras here. Read `extra_costs`.

total.description:
The order total: what was ordered (goods less discounts, plus tax). Extra costs entered
at receipt are never in it — see `extra_costs`.

extra_costs.description:
Extra costs entered at receipt, summed from the receipts: each kind, their total, the part
the supplier charged (in what is owed) and the part paid to someone else (never owed to it).

received_goods.description: Goods received so far at the supplier's price (Σ receipts' goods value).

payable_total.description: What the supplier is owed for so far: received goods + extra costs it charged. `due_amount` = this − `paid_amount`.

is_late.description: Waiting for stock and past its expected date (Dhaka today).

is_paid.description: Something was received and paid, and nothing is owed on it. catalog.view_cost only.

payment_due_date.description:
When what is owed falls due: the first delivery's Dhaka date plus the supplier's
payment terms; null while nothing is owed. catalog.view_cost only.

landed_unit_cost.description: Quantity-weighted landed cost over every receipt so far, 4 dp; null before the first.

units_received.description: Units received so far over every line.

is_late.description: Waiting for stock and past its expected date (Dhaka today).

is_paid.description: Something was received and paid, and nothing is owed on it. catalog.view_cost only.

total.description: The order total: what was ordered (goods), never a receipt's extra costs.

supplier_known.description: True when a supplier was named, so a null `last_unit_cost` means "new to this supplier".

costs_vendor.description: Who charged the landed costs when not the supplier.

payable_amount.description: What the supplier is owed for this delivery.

week_ends.description: The Friday ending this Saturday–Friday week, Y-m-d.

open_count.description: POs waiting for stock (ordered or partly received).

arriving_count.description: Open POs expected from today to `week_ends`.

late_count.description: Open POs past their expected date.

owed.description: What we owe suppliers for stock received: the sum of positive supplier balances. finance.view only.

owed_suppliers.description: How many suppliers we owe. finance.view only.

PurchaseTrigger.description: Which order event fires the `purchase` conversion (PRD K-02). Exactly one of them, never both: `order_placed` counts every order the moment it is placed (fast feedback for ad optimisation, includes COD orders that later fail); `order_delivered` counts only orders the customer accepted and paid for (truer in a COD market, but days late and server-only: the browser is gone by then).
PurchaseTrigger.title: PurchaseTrigger

QuoteDueCollectionRequest.description: `POST /pos/sessions/{session}/due-collections/quote` — read the tenders against the customer's open due. Writes nothing.

customer_phone.description: The customer's mobile, as typed (013–019, rule 30).

amount.description: What the customer handed over in this tender; cash may exceed the due (change).

reference.description: bKash / Nagad TrxID or the card slip's approval code. Required for every non-cash tender.

QuoteDueCollectionRequest.title: QuoteDueCollectionRequest

QuotePosSaleRequest.description:
`POST /pos/sessions/{session}/quote` — price the register cart and read the tenders.
Writes nothing. Every figure on the register comes from here (rule 1).

coupon_code.description: A storefront coupon; applied by the same rules as checkout. Needs `customer_phone`.

customer_phone.description: Bangladeshi mobile (013–019, rule 30). Optional — an anonymous walk-in has none.

discount.description: The cashier's discount, taken off the goods after promotions and the coupon. Capped by the store (`discount_max_percent` on the quote).

type.description: `percent` of the goods, or a flat `amount` in taka.

reason.description: Why — one of the fixed reasons, kept with the sale.

method.description: `due` puts that amount on the customer's due (needs `pos.sell_on_due`, a phone and a name).

amount.description: What the customer handed over in this tender, e.g. `4000.00` cash for a ৳3,455 total.

reference.description: bKash / Nagad TrxID or the card slip's approval code. Required for every non-cash tender.

customer_name.description: The name the cashier typed for a new customer — a due tender needs one.

QuotePosSaleRequest.title: QuotePosSaleRequest

QuotePurchaseRequest.description:
`POST /purchases/quote` — the New / edit purchase order form's lines, priced by the
server before anything is saved (rule 1). Same line rules as the PO itself; the supplier
is optional and only adds "last bought at". Needs purchasing.create.

supplier_id.description: Adds each line's `last_unit_cost` from this supplier's earlier purchase orders.

unit_cost.description: The supplier's price per unit, up to 4 decimals.

discount.description: Discount on the whole line, in taka.

QuotePurchaseRequest.title: QuotePurchaseRequest

ReceivePurchaseRequest.description:
`POST /purchases/{purchase}/receipts` and `…/receipts/quote` — the units arriving per
PO line, where they go, and the landed costs to split across them. The quote takes
the same body and returns every figure the receipt would write; needs
purchasing.receive. Over-receipt and unknown lines are 422s from ReceiptCalculator.

location_id.description: Where the goods are put away; the PO's location when omitted.

quantity.description: Units arriving now; 0 skips the line.

freight.description: Inbound freight for this delivery, in taka.

customs_duty.description: Customs and import duty for this delivery, in taka.

other_cost.description: Any other landed cost (labour, loading, insurance), in taka.

apportion_method.description: How the landed costs are split across lines; by value when omitted.

costs_paid_to_supplier.description: Whether the supplier charged the landed costs on its invoice (they add to what we owe it). Default true.

costs_vendor.description: Who charged the landed costs when not the supplier (freight forwarder, C&F agent). Only with `costs_paid_to_supplier: false`.

anyOf.description: How they were paid, if already paid; omit when the bill is still open.

ReceivePurchaseRequest.title: ReceivePurchaseRequest

RecommendationPlacement.description: Where a recommendation was shown (DATABASE-DESIGN §3.1 `recommendation_events.placement`). The placement that put a line in the cart travels on `cart_items.recommendation_source` and is stamped onto `order_items.recommendation_source` at checkout (rule 25d), so the P&L can attribute what each placement actually sold. There is deliberately no checkout placement (rule 25b).
RecommendationPlacement.title: RecommendationPlacement

RecordCapitalEntryRequest.description:
`POST /finance/capital/entries` — owner capital put in (`contribution`, "New investment")
or taken out (`drawing`): `kind`, `holder_id` (an active holder), `amount` (decimal string,
> 0), `occurred_on` (a Dhaka date, not in the future), `method` (the expense payment
methods), optional `reference` and `note`. Needs finance.manage_capital and an
`Idempotency-Key` (it moves money).
RecordCapitalEntryRequest.title: RecordCapitalEntryRequest

RecordCodReceiptRequest.description:
`POST /finance/orders/{order}/cod-receipts` — cash received from the courier for one
delivered COD order: `amount` (> 0, ≤ outstanding), `received_on` (a Dhaka date, not in
the future), optional `reference` (the courier's payment id) and `note`. Needs
finance.reconcile_cod and an `Idempotency-Key`.
RecordCodReceiptRequest.title: RecordCodReceiptRequest

RejectHeldOrderRequest.description:
`POST /risk/orders/{order}/reject` — a person cancels a held order: `reason` (a
CancellationReason, required) and `note` (required for `other`). Needs risk.verify AND
orders.cancel. The only cancel the queue has — scoring never cancels (rule 23).
RejectHeldOrderRequest.title: RejectHeldOrderRequest

RejectRefundRequest.description: `POST /refunds/{refund}/reject` — same permission as approving it; a reason is required.
RejectRefundRequest.title: RejectRefundRequest

RejectReturnRequest.description: `POST /returns/{orderReturn}/reject` — needs returns.manage; a reason is required.
RejectReturnRequest.title: RejectReturnRequest

RejectStockAdjustmentRequest.description: `POST /inventory/adjustments/{adjustment}/reject` — needs inventory.approve_adjustments. Writes no movement; the reason is required.
RejectStockAdjustmentRequest.title: RejectStockAdjustmentRequest

RelationType.description: `product_relations.type` (DATABASE-DESIGN §3.1). `age_progression` is its own type, not a flavour of upsell: an upsell is a better version of the same toy; an age progression is the next toy, for a child who has outgrown this one.
RelationType.title: RelationType

ReorderAttributeValuesRequest.description:
`POST /attributes/{attribute}/values/reorder` — `{ ids: [3, 1, 2] }`, every value
id of the attribute exactly once, in the new display order.
ReorderAttributeValuesRequest.title: ReorderAttributeValuesRequest

ReorderCmsBlocksRequest.description: `PUT /content/home/order` — `ids`: every draft block id, in the new order.
ReorderCmsBlocksRequest.title: ReorderCmsBlocksRequest

ReorderProductImagesRequest.description:
`POST /products/{product}/images/reorder` — `{ ids: [3, 1, 2] }`, every image id
of the product exactly once, in display order. Needs catalog.update.
ReorderProductImagesRequest.title: ReorderProductImagesRequest

ReorderTestimonialsRequest.description: `POST /content/testimonials/reorder` — `ids`: every testimonial id, once, in the new order.
ReorderTestimonialsRequest.title: ReorderTestimonialsRequest

ReplaceMediaRequest.description:
`POST /media/{media}/replace` — `multipart/form-data`, `file` of the same kind as the
media (image ↔ image, PDF ↔ PDF), ≤ 10 MB, checked by content. Needs media.manage.
ReplaceMediaRequest.title: ReplaceMediaRequest

ReplyToReviewRequest.description: `PUT /reviews/{review}/reply` — the shop's public reply; null or "" removes it. Needs reviews.moderate.
ReplyToReviewRequest.title: ReplyToReviewRequest

ReportFrequency.description: How often a scheduled report goes out, and which Dhaka-date period each send covers: daily    every day; covers the previous day   weekly   every Saturday; covers the previous Saturday–Friday week (the shop's week,            ReportPeriod::WEEK_STARTS_ON)   monthly  on the 1st; covers the previous calendar month
ReportFrequency.title: ReportFrequency

ReportScheduleRequest.description:
A scheduled report, for `POST /reports/schedules` and `PUT /reports/schedules/{schedule}`
(the full document both times).

- `send_time` is HH:MM in Asia/Dhaka, on a quarter hour (the sweep runs every 15 minutes).
- `recipient_ids` are staff users only — never a free-typed address — each active and
  holding the report type's permissions (ReportType::requiredPermissions()).
- The actor must be able to open the report type themselves.
ReportScheduleRequest.title: ReportScheduleRequest

resend_count.description: How many times staff resent this run (P9).

last_resent_by.description: The staff member who last resent it — name only.

deliveries.description:
Each recipient's copy (P9; empty on runs from before per-recipient records, or when
not loaded). Staff names only, never an email address.

ReportType.title: ReportType

RequestOtpRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/auth/otp` (P4-STO-11) — text a sign-in code. Called by the Next.js
server with its storefront token; the route's ability authorises it.
RequestOtpRequest.title: RequestOtpRequest

RequestShipmentRequest.description:
`POST /orders/{order}/shipments` — send one order to a courier (P6, DATABASE-DESIGN §4.2).
Needs orders.update + shipments.book; `Idempotency-Key` required (rule 17).

provider.description: Courier provider code (e.g. `steadfast`, `pathao`). Omitted: the active default provider.

courier_location_id.description: A mapped `courier_locations` id of that provider — required in effect when the address's upazila maps to several zones (rule 32).

weight_grams.description: Parcel weight in grams, overriding Σ variant weight × quantity.

RequestShipmentRequest.title: RequestShipmentRequest

ResendReportRunRequest.description:
`POST /reports/schedules/{schedule}/runs/{run}/resend` (P9) — resend a failed run for the
same period. Needs reports.view + reports.export (ReportSchedulePolicy::resend), and the
actor must be able to open the report type themselves.

- no body (or `user_id: null`): every copy that failed or never went out;
- `user_id`: that one recipient's copy — a current recipient of the schedule, still active
  and still holding the report's permissions (re-checked now, and again at send time).

user_id.description: One recipient's copy only; omit for every failed copy.

ResendReportRunRequest.title: ResendReportRunRequest

ResetPasswordRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/auth/password/reset` (owner decision 2026-11-20) — the `password_reset` code
and the new password. An optional `X-Cart-Token` names the guest cart to merge on sign-in.
ResetPasswordRequest.title: ResetPasswordRequest

ResetStaffPasswordRequest.description: `POST /staff/{user}/password` — `{ password }`, a new temporary password; needs staff.manage.
ResetStaffPasswordRequest.title: ResetStaffPasswordRequest

window.description: The sales window, Dhaka dates inclusive (30 days ending today).

rows.description: Variants that run out within the horizon plus their lead time, the soonest first.

note.description: Today's cached AI note for exactly these figures, if one was written.

note_blocked.description: Why no note can be written (`figures_not_shared`, `nothing_to_order`), else null.

sentences.description: At most three sentences; empty when omitted.

model.description: The model id that wrote it.

RestockNoteRequest.description: `POST /inventory/restock/note` — the AI note for the forecast at this horizon; needs inventory.view.

fresh.description: Write a new note even when today's note for this forecast is cached.

RestockNoteRequest.title: RestockNoteRequest

RestoreCartRequest.description: `POST /cart/restore` `{token}` — the token from a recovery SMS link (P7).
RestoreCartRequest.title: RestoreCartRequest

ReturnReason.description: Why a customer sent goods back. Counted by cause, so a fixed list; `other` needs a note.
ReturnReason.title: ReturnReason

ReverseCapitalEntryRequest.description:
`POST /finance/capital/entries/{entry}/reverse` — `reason` (required, 3–500 characters; kept
as the reversal's note). Needs finance.manage_capital and an `Idempotency-Key`.
ReverseCapitalEntryRequest.title: ReverseCapitalEntryRequest

RevertCmsLayoutRequest.description:
`POST /content/home/versions/{version}/revert` — `publish` (default true) puts the old
version live again as a new version; false only restores it into the draft.
RevertCmsLayoutRequest.title: RevertCmsLayoutRequest

ReviewSettlementLineRequest.title: ReviewSettlementLineRequest

RobotsDirective.description: The robots meta values the admin may choose (SeoPanel "Advanced").
RobotsDirective.title: RobotsDirective

Role.description: The 7 launch roles (DATABASE-DESIGN §3.10, PRD P-01) and their DEFAULT permissions. Since the owner decision of 2026-11-14 roles are editable in the admin (Settings → Staff & roles), so at runtime the database (`role_has_permissions`) is authoritative and {@see self::permissions()} is what a role starts with: the seeder applies it to a role or a permission it creates, never over the owner's edits. The 403 role-matrix tests run on a freshly seeded database, so they still exercise exactly these defaults.  super_admin is seeded with every permission AND bypasses all gates via Gate::before (App\Providers\AuthServiceProvider); it is the only role that bypasses.

trend.description:
One row per bucket (Saturday-start weeks), Dhaka dates. `previous_*` is the
comparison range's bucket at the same position, or null.

conversion.description:
Conversion is not reported: no server-side page views and consent-gated browser
events leave no defensible session denominator.

SaveAccountChildRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/account/children` and `PATCH …/children/{child}` (P8 batch 3) — the signed-in
parent adds or edits one of their own children. PATCH replaces every field.

name.description: First name or nickname — optional; nothing else about the child is stored.

birth_day.description: 1–31; 29 February is fine (celebrated 28 February in other years).

birth_year.description: Optional, only to show an age; within the last 25 years.

SaveAccountChildRequest.title: SaveAccountChildRequest

SaveAdSpendRequest.description:
`POST /analytics/marketing/spend` and `PUT /analytics/marketing/spend/{adSpend}` — ad spend
typed in by staff: `campaign` (the `utm_campaign` value it pays for, ≤ 128), optional
`source` (facebook, google …, ≤ 64), `month` (YYYY-MM, a Dhaka month from 2020-01 up to the
current one), `amount` (a decimal string > 0, two places at most) and an optional `note`.
One row per campaign and month: a second one for the same pair is a 422 on `month`
(campaign compared trimmed and case-insensitively). Needs marketing.manage.
SaveAdSpendRequest.title: SaveAdSpendRequest

SaveAiKeyRequest.description: `PUT /settings/ai/providers/{provider}` — connect a provider with its API key; needs settings.manage_integrations.

api_key.description: The provider's secret API key. Checked with a real call before it is saved; never returned.

SaveAiKeyRequest.title: SaveAiKeyRequest

SaveCustomerChildRequest.description:
`POST /customers/{customer}/children` and `PATCH …/children/{child}` (P8 batch 3) — staff add
or edit a child as the parent told them. Children's data: customers.update AND
customers.view_pii (rule 20). PATCH replaces every field.

name.description: First name or nickname — optional; nothing else about the child is stored.

birth_day.description: 1–31; 29 February is fine (celebrated 28 February in other years).

birth_year.description: Optional, only to show an age; within the last 25 years.

SaveCustomerChildRequest.title: SaveCustomerChildRequest

SaveRedirectRequest.description:
`POST /seo/redirects` and `PATCH /seo/redirects/{redirect}`. Shape only; the
conflict, loop and chain rules live in App\Domain\Seo\Actions\SaveRedirect.
SaveRedirectRequest.title: SaveRedirectRequest

SaveSeoMetaRequest.description:
`PUT /seo/meta/{type}/{id}` — the whole SEO document of one page (SeoPanel). Every text
field is optional (empty = the server default); a save replaces the stored document.

og_image.description: Media Library picks are served over http on a local machine; production stays https-only.

SaveSeoMetaRequest.title: SaveSeoMetaRequest

SendInboxReplyRequest.description:
`POST /inbox/conversations/{conversation}/messages` — a reply to the customer, needs
inbox.reply. Queued; sent after commit. 409 outside the 24-hour window.

body.description: WhatsApp's text limit (4096). Messenger publishes no limit we could confirm.

SendInboxReplyRequest.title: SendInboxReplyRequest

name as `GET …/templates` lists it, `language` its Meta code, `parameters` the positional

SendInboxTemplateRequest.title: SendInboxTemplateRequest

SendQuickReplyRequest.description:
